span.p:
git push → main
or PR merge

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
① Test
pytest backend/tests/
fail → block deploy

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
② Build Backend Image
docker build -f Dockerfile.backend
tag: latest + SHA

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
③ Build Worker Image
docker build -f Dockerfile.worker
tag: latest + SHA

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
④ ECR Push
aws ecr get-login-token
docker push backend:SHA
docker push worker:SHA

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⑤ DB Migration
ecs run-task
--overrides cmd=alembic upgrade head
wait for EXIT 0
fail → block deploy

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⑥ Deploy Web Service
ecs update-service
--image backend:SHA
wait for STABLE

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⑦ Deploy Worker Service
ecs update-service
--image worker:SHA
wait for STABLE

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⑧ Frontend Build
npm ci
VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.interview.example.in
npm run build

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⑨ S3 Sync
aws s3 sync dist/ s3://project08-frontend-prod/
--delete

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⑩ CloudFront Invalidation
aws cloudfront create-invalidation
--paths /*
ensures fresh index.html

span.p:
ECS Web Service
Rolling update
2 new tasks up
2 old tasks drain
